summary: Round 2 is a valid comparison: before 18/100 versus installed 26/100 corrected wins. The favorable difference remains inconclusive, including cumulatively. Continue the predeclared series without changing decks or repeating trials.
findings: Read AGENTS.md, the C17 brief, manifest, batch, prior round JSON/Markdown reviews, runner and relevant supervisor logic. Read and analyzed both summaries, all 199 completed game logs, 200 original stdout files and all 200 hand-stream files; the externally killed game's stream is empty. No simulations, modifications, purchases or engine changes were performed.

Controls verified: both source deck SHA256 values match the manifest, and Forge-loaded copies match except Name. All frozen runtime files and all five group/schedule hashes match. Both round-2 trials.json files are byte-identical to predeclared trials-b2.json; all 100 summary trial IDs, seeds, pods and cases match. Completed logs identify the scheduled opponents in their prescribed seats. The timeout lacks a completed log, so its opponent identities cannot be independently reconstructed from that log.

Both summaries record classesSha 601627412546ce7c and cardsSha 02c2b0e93031edd8, with the correct respective deck hashes. Runner SHA256 remains ae37d38643cc55746f97064cfc26270f9c52d9c1ae52efe33b420521088d3d27. Runner code supplies each scheduled seed and identical seating, enables SMART_AI/POLITICS and clears the listed additional tactics/full-state flags. PodSim uses supplied seed + 1 for these single-game processes. These verify recorded artifacts and execution code, rather than providing independent cryptographic attestations of every process.

Before: 18 raw and corrected wins, 99 clean finishes, one external timeout/suspect counted as a scheduled draw. Installed: 26 raw and corrected wins, 100 clean finishes, no suspects or timeouts. Independent completed-log winner/conflict checks found no discrepancies. Clean-only rates are 18/99=18.2% versus 26/100=26.0%; corrected/all-start nominal Wilson 95% intervals are 11.7–26.7% versus 18.4–35.4%.

Timeout evidence: before b2pod10-c3, seed 23210000, has an original timeout JSON recording elapsedSeconds 610.0, wallLimitSeconds 610 and process-group termination by c17-round.py. Its preserved stdout repeatedly reports invalid Belonging attack declarations. There is no completed game log or ordinary simulated finish. This is an externally terminated synthetic scheduled draw, not a completed loss or win. Installed completed the paired trial normally in 53113 ms and lost.

Round-2 shared clean pairing: 99 trials; both win 10, installed-only wins 16, before-only wins 8, neither wins 65. Paired difference is +8.08 percentage points, nominal approximate 95% interval −1.49 to +17.65 points; exact two-sided McNemar p=0.1516. This does not establish improvement. Pod dependence, AI timing variability and repeated interim inspection limit nominal inference.

Group b1 remains before 25/100 versus installed 26/100 corrected, raw 27 versus 28, suspects 2 versus 3. Group b2 is 18/100 versus 26/100, raw identical, suspects 1 versus 0. Cumulative corrected outcomes are 43/200=21.5% versus 52/200=26.0%; raw 45 versus 54, suspects 3 versus 3. Cumulative clean-only rates are 43/197=21.8% versus 52/197=26.4%. Groups b3–b5 remain outside this review.

Across 196 cumulative shared clean trials: both win 20, installed-only 32, before-only 23, neither 121. Paired difference +4.59 points, nominal approximate 95% interval −2.80 to +11.98 points; exact McNemar p=0.2806. Preserve group distinctions and complete the fixed schedule; neither superiority nor equality is proven.

Round-2 corrected before/installed wins by pod 01–20: 1/2, 2/1, 1/1, 2/3, 3/2, 0/0, 0/3, 0/1, 1/0, 0/1, 0/3, 1/0, 0/0, 1/2, 0/1, 1/1, 2/2, 1/0, 0/1, 2/2. Gains are uneven across pods; no opponent group was removed to improve the headline.

Commander observations in each arm's clean games: before cast T'Challa in 98/99 games, 159 cast events and 44 games with recasts; installed 97/100, 149 events and 39 games with recasts. Median first cast was personal turn 4 versus 3. Original-commander attack declarations were 198 versus 260; recorded player combat damage totaled 936 versus 1608; blocker assignments against him were 39 versus 56. Battlefield departure records were 93 versus 97. These describe activity, not continuous survival duration or a demonstrated survival improvement.

Clean logs record 426 versus 491 resolutions of T'Challa's tapped-Vibranium creation description. Installed records 32 Mystic Forge activation declarations and seven Nettlecyst equip declarations. These support active artifact development but do not measure exact available mana, token inventory or causal card value.

Added-card hand-exposure/cast-game counts across 100 installed clean games: Foundry Inspector 26/19; Clever Concealment 25/4; Path to Exile 31/24; Akroma's Will 29/16; Bronze Guardian 30/19; Mystic Forge 28/14; Winds of Abandon 31/19; Wurmcoil Engine 34/22; Nettlecyst 27/22; Forsaken Monument 29/19; Thousand Moons Smithy 25/9. Exposure includes opening/mulligan hands and is not equivalent to a retained draw. All additions were cast; low casting frequency alone does not establish that a card was stranded or weak. Mystic Forge retains AI:RemoveDeck:Random.

Concrete case 1: installed b2pod14-c4 cast Akroma's Will with T'Challa present; the log resolves both modes, including flying, double strike and protection. T'Challa then attacked unblocked and dealt two 8-point player hits during that combat. Later attacks still encountered blockers after temporary evasion expired. Installed won normally in 25278 ms; before lost this seed in 68471 ms. This demonstrates functioning temporary evasion and an installed-only win, without isolating Akroma's Will as its sole cause.

Concrete case 2: installed b2pod07-c3 developed Forsaken Monument and Wurmcoil Engine. T'Challa connected for 6 and 8, but later attacks dealt 22 to Akroma, 22 and 32 to Zombie tokens, and 36 to Dreadhound rather than their players. Clever Concealment explicitly phased out seven named permanents; Nettlecyst created its Germ and Bronze Guardian was subsequently cast. Installed won normally in 96192 ms while before lost in 35475 ms. Large commander size still failed to bypass recorded blockers, despite the eventual army win.

Concrete mana limitation: installed b2pod19-c3 played four Plains and Throne of the High City, cast artifacts but never cast T'Challa, and recorded Nature's Lore in its last nonempty hand. That is evidence of a specific green-access/development problem, not a measured general color-screw rate. Both arms lost that trial normally. Empty terminal hand snapshots reflect cleanup and must not be interpreted as an empty hand throughout the game.

Full-state capture was disabled. Exact mana payment, continuous survival times, complete legal-blocking alternatives and all reasons for held cards are unavailable. Recorded blocker assignments demonstrate actual blocks; unblocked attacks alone do not prove the opponent could legally block. Equipment reassignment, commander prioritization and protection timing remain AI limitations. Card-conditioned outcomes are associations, not individual causal effects.

The comparison remains between the authorized modeled lists: Divine Visitation in both and the disclosed Mind's Eye cut for Forsaken Monument. It does not certify physical inventory or complete bracket legality. The supervisor consumes structured reviewed:true/continue output before advancing; shared Markdown alone is not the continuation mechanism.
